The Principia LuaScript API Cheatsheet is available in two different versions - one normal colour version and one greyscale version with high black-and-white contrast optimised for greyscale printers.

Here is an old picture of me holding the greyscale version, printed out on the old printer we have at home.

Get it for free now! You don't even need to print it out of course.

https://principia-web.se/luascript-api-cheatsheet
